text:
max: Quick heads-up — found a flaky case in sample-app streaming resume. After abort+reconnect the client sometimes sees stray control bytes and out-of-order event fragments, causing parse failures.
anya: can you reproduce consistently? which SDK/runtime?
max: js/browser SDK using fetch polyfill, behind our dev mitm proxy. ~4% of reconnects fail during heavy local traffic. Direct to backend is clean.
leo: raw bytes?
max: paste from local trace:
[recv] 0x00 0x1f 0x7b 0x22 0x69 0x64  -> leading NUL/control then '{"id"'
[recv] data: {"id":"2","text":"second"}
[recv] data: {"id":"1","text":"first"}
[parser] combined => '\u0000{"id":"2"...}{"id":"1"...}' -> json parse error
anya: sounds like proxy is reusing buffers or interleaving writes on pooled connections. Any auth refresh around the same time?
max: yes sometimes token refresh happens concurrently in repro. I added repro steps to sample-app/streaming/REPRO.md: force short TTL and trigger refresh during reconnect.
leo: short-term SDK mitigations: 1) Trim leading control bytes (<=0x1f) before feeding parser, but log metric when trimming; 2) Buffer incoming bytes and only split events on full SSE separator ('\n\n'); 3) Optional small reorder buffer keyed by event id/seq (N=8, timeout 200ms) to tolerate brief out-of-order delivery.
max: implemented a tiny client-side patch that trims leading control bytes and waits for '\n\n' — fixed my local flakiness. Opening PR behind a feature flag.
anya: infra please collect a pcap on next repro and try toggling keepalive/pooling behavior on dev proxy. If we can reproduce by disabling pooling, that'll point to pooled-write interleave.
infra-bot: INF-1302 filed: "dev-proxy: investigate pooled connection writes -> stray control bytes / interleaved SSE fragments".
devex-bot: DEX-1500 created: "streaming: defensive parser (trim/control-byte metrics, buffer-on-delimiter, optional reorder buffer) + infra pcap".
leo: for SDK PR add unit tests: clipped-leading-bytes case, interleaved-write harness that emits seq=2 then seq=1, and ensure comments/retry lines are preserved. Also add telemetry counters: sse.trimmed_bytes and sse.reorder_events.
max: will attach the minimal server harness and logs to DEX-1500. Server snippet used for repro:
```js
// intentionally write part A then B to simulate interleave
res.write('\u0000data: {"id":"2","text":"second"}\n\n');
setTimeout(()=>res.write('data: {"id":"1","text":"first"}\n\n'), 1);
```
anya: good. once infra gives pcap we'll correlate raw TCP with proxy behavior. keep defensive client change behind a flag and monitor telemetry so we don't silently hide infra bug.
max: agreed. PR and issue links in DEX-1500. short thread but actionable. :thumbsup:
